title: 🔴LIVE: Anime Expo 2026 Day 1 - All the Major News & Announcements
content: Anime Expo 2026 has officially started, and it’s set to reveal dozens of new trailers, visuals, and announcements for all the hype anime. Follow with us live as we go through each day and share everything that gets announced. Starting with Day 1, July 2.
author: Anime Corner

title: 'Koori no Jouheki' Gets Second Season in Fall 2026
content: The 14th and final episode of Koori no Jouheki ( The Ramparts of Ice ) ended with an announcement on Friday that a second season is in production. The official website also revealed a teaser visual (pictured). The second season is scheduled to premiere on October 1 at 11:56 p.m. on TBS' 28 affiliated stations.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Disney+ is Adding Anime Movies to its Library (Including Akira), But There’s a Catch
content: We don’t need to tell you that anime is growing as an industry in North America, with Disney being one of the entertainment studios that has taken notice. Thanks to this fact, Disney+ has been housing more anime as part of its library in recent years worldwide.
author: ComicBook

title: Netflix’s Latest Returning Live-Action Confirms One Piece Is the Platform’s Biggest Success
content: Netflix ‘s live-action adaptation of One Piece returned with a new season in March of this year, continuing the Straw Hats’ adventure in the Grand Line while providing a fresh take on the previous story arc.
author: ComicBook

title: Black Clover Shares New Season 2 Preview For Series Return
content: One of the biggest comebacks of the fall anime season is Black Clover , the shonen anime adaptation from Studio Pierrot that hasn’t released a new episode in over five years. title: Crunchyroll’s Acclaimed Sci-Fi Series Confirms New Physical Release Date After Finale
content: Now that the exciting Summer 2026 anime season is here, almost all the Spring shows have reached their conclusions. The beloved new additions to the anime world, such as Witch Hat Atelier and Nippon Sangoku , have already confirmed their sequel seasons, and there are more exciting updates to follow this month.
author: ComicBook

title: Disney Plus Expands Anime Library in UK and France With 10+ Films Including Your Name, Weathering with You, Wolf Children and More
content: Disney+ has announced a new licensing agreement with Anime Ltd. that will bring more than 10 anime films to subscribers in the U.K. and France, with releases beginning later this year.
author: Anime Corner

title: The Ramparts of Ice Gets Season 2 in October 2026
content: The Ramparts of Ice is getting a Season 2 which is set to release on October 1, 2026. The announcement was made after the premiere of the 14th episode of season one. A teaser visual was also released. Mankyu directed the first season at Studio KAI with Yasuhiro Nakanishi doing the series composition.
author: Anime Corner

title: Eleceed Anime First Trailer Introduces Main Voice Cast
content: The upcoming ELECEED anime has revealed the first trailer and main voice cast ahead of show’s early 2027 release. It was originally planned to release this year . The anime is being produced by studio DandeLion Animation Studio, known for its work on THE FIRST SLAM DUNK and the short film Magic Candies .
author: Anime Corner
